description.value: A retrospective multicenter study developing and validating three automated volumetric MRI biomarkers for detecting frontotemporal dementia and differentiating its clinical subtypes from other diagnostic groups.

spans.text: In this retrospective multicenter study, we developed three diagnostic imaging biomarkers (API, ASI, and TPL), derived from volumetric MRI, for diagnosis of FTD and separation of FTD subtypes.

value: API separated FTD from non-FTD with a sensitivity of 59% and an AUC of 83% at a specificity close to 95%.
API detected a distinct frontotemporal MRI pattern in 59% of all FTD patients, while many remaining FTD cases demonstrated a subcortical atrophy pattern similar to AD.
